RBI Report Finds Indian Financial System Resilient Amid Global Economic Uncertainty

The Reserve Bank of India's latest report on financial stability has found that the domestic financial system remains resilient despite external shocks. The report attributes this resilience to various factors, including prudent monetary policy and a strong regulatory framework. However, it also warns of potential risks from AI-driven cyber attacks and other external threats. The RBI governor emphasizes the need for vigilance in addressing these risks.
